_readme: Minimum number of checks each test file must report. Written by `npm run test:floor`; read by tests/run.js. A file reporting FEWER checks than its floor fails the run — that is a check which used to be enforced and silently is not. More is always fine. null = deliberately unfloored (prints no parseable count, or the count is not deterministic). See tests/lib/check_ledger.js.
